title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent FOH recording captures a high‑energy Red Rocks show with monster Let It Grow, Spanish Jam and a tight, adventurous second set.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an airy yet clear sound that many reviewers call “A+” despite a few level complaints. Musically the concert is praised for its adventurous playing, especially the soaring Let It Grow, fiery Spanish Jam, and solid drumming, making it one of the standout ’82 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments (10/11 five‑star) highlight both a superb recording and an exciting show; the lone low rating is an outlier about taper levels.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FOB mix described as airy, soft yet clear; new transfers praised for crispness. Some reviewers note the taper’s level adjustments and a missing banter edit, but overall sound is deemed A+.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual song placements keep the set fresh; second set is highlighted as tight and adventurous with strong transitions.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s vocal hiccup during Let It Grow is noted, but his performance remains praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers are highlighted for a tight, energetic segment, especially within the space/Spanish Jam.
